name: Nishino Shizuka
source:
A housewife married for 20 years with a 20-year-old son.

On the day of her trip, her husband is unable to accompany her due to work commitments, and she meets the protagonist while traveling alone and lonely.

She sees her first love in the main character and enjoys a whirlwind romance with him as if she were young again.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=975642&gc=gc]Getchu[/url]]
